description:
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Gogo.
Holding priority, activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Gogo by paying {4} and tapping it, copying the North Pole Patrol ability, targeting Gogo and Vhal.
Resolve both copies of the North Pole Patrol abilities, untapping Gogo and Vhal.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Vhal, Candlekeep Researcher
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with toughness 5 or greater
